name: ads-and-promo
description: Plan and make ads, product shots, thumbnails, launch and store graphics, and app demo videos with Glif, from the user's real product photos or app screens. Use when: "make an ad", "UGC-style ads", "Meta ads", "ad creatives", "angles to test", "turn these reviews into ads", "product photos for my shop", "Amazon or Shopify listing images", "lifestyle shots of this product", "YouTube thumbnail", "App Store screenshots", "Play Store feature graphic", "launch graphics", "Product Hunt images", "social posts for the launch", "carousel", "promo banner", "a week of posts", "launch campaign", "storyboard this ad", "resize this ad for every format", "headline variations", "demo video of my app", "launch video", "product walkthrough". NOT for: general images or logos (use images), or video and audio that isn't promoting a product (use video-and-audio).

findings.excerpt: Download into a folder outside the shipped site, such as `marketing/`, with `curl -fsSL "<media url>" -o <path>`. Use one folder per channel, like `marketing/ap
